spec.text: Image 1 is the woman's character model sheet; image 2 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Close-up of the woman's hands holding a smartphone upright in a cozy room at night, warm lamp light, background softly blurred. The phone screen faces the camera, is in sharp focus and is completely blank, plain light grey, with no interface, no icons and no text. Only her hands and a bit of her sweater sleeves are visible. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
